**Synchronous (sync)** means tasks run strictly one after another. The program pauses and waits for each task to finish before moving to the next line of code. It's straightforward but can freeze your app if a task (like a network request) takes time.

**Asynchronous (async)** means tasks can run independently. The program starts a task and immediately moves on to other work instead of waiting. When the task completes, it signals the program to handle the result (using callbacks, promises, or `async/await`). This keeps interfaces responsive.
